answer: Make tenure a memory-hard sequential proof: each epoch an identity extends a hash chain whose steps need the previous output and large RAM, and voting weight grows with verified chain length. A voyage of unbroken epochs cannot be parallelised or bought in bulk. The chain is bound to the identity by a cipher key and is non-transferable, so an old relic cannot be sold or rented without breaking it. A farm of n clones pays n separate RAM allocations and n separate voyages every epoch.
